finding: Content addressing and plan/goal/term binding detect mutation, mismatch, and cross-goal transplantation but do not authenticate a malicious writer with access to the same repository-local evidence store.
resolution: The API, CLI, OpenSpec contract/design, user documentation, and report now require trusted Ladon-generated local cache data and explicitly exclude malicious same-user writers from the threat model. The auditor accepted the documentation correction and found no other actionable issue in the reviewed scope.
scopeLimit: The audit did not rerun the full project regression suite.
